lines.text_source:
WEST – Sibuna Desert
EAST – Spider Lair
lines.speaker: system
lines.base_translation: OESTE – Deserto de Sibuna Este – Toca da Aranha

lines.text_source: This place don't seem so different from the fields back home, does it?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Este lugar não parece muito diferente dos campos de casa, né?

lines.text_source: We've got no way of reachin' General Brigard. We've started to 'ave a look at the perimeter, but I'd much rather've been in his regiment, that's for certain.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: A gente não consegue alcançar o General Brigard. Começamos a verificar o perímetro, mas preferia estar no regimento dele, com certeza.
lines.risk_notes: Character voice undefined; translated with contemporary pt-BR colloquial forms ('reachin', ''ave') → natural equivalents ('alcançar', 'temos'). Verify tone consistency with broader NPC military register if available.

lines.speaker: system
lines.base_translation: OESTE – Hafin Este – Pântano de Hel

lines.text_source: Hmmm... I can do it, it's not that high.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Hmmm... Consigo fazer, não é tão alto assim.

lines.text_source: Better plan your jumps if you don't want to fall down 'ere like me. Takin' a leap right at the last second might just do it.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Planeje bem seus pulos se não quer cair. Um salto no último segundo pode funcionar.
lines.risk_notes: Colloquial register ('plan your jumps', 'don't want', ''ere', 'Takin'') compressed for byte budget (124). Reformulated with natural pt-BR concision ('planeje bem seus pulos'; 'no último segundo') to fit. Verify in-game display does not overflow TextMeshPro box.

lines.text_source: The drop from these platforms doesn't seem too steep. Shouldn't be hard to climb up and down 'em.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: A queda dessas plataformas não parece muito íngreme. Não deve ser difícil subir e descer.
lines.risk_notes: Colloquial ''em' → 'delas' reformulated for concision (byte budget 97). Preserved informal register. Verify tone consistency with Soldier4/6 if part of same dialogue cluster.

lines.text_source: Climbing down, jumpin', blockin'... What's all this then? Some sorta testin' ground?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Escalando, pulando, bloqueando... Que é isso? Algum lugar de testes?
lines.risk_notes: Colloquial gerunds ('Climbing', 'jumpin'', 'blockin'') and rhetorical question suggest low-rank soldier confusion. Translated with natural pt-BR gerund forms ('Escalando', 'pulando', 'bloqueando') and maintained tone. 'testin' ground' → 'lugar de testes'. Verify consistency with broader military NPC voice profile.
